source: National Crime Records Bureau (NCRB) & Tamil Nadu Police Crime Statistics

Chennai.safety_recommendations: Beware of pickpocketing in crowded transport terminals (Koyambedu, Central), avoid isolated beach corridors after 11 PM.

Chengalpattu.safety_recommendations: Keep vehicle doors locked around highway tolls, stick to main GST highway hotels.

Kanchipuram.safety_recommendations: Safe heritage zone during daytime, exercise standard caution around peripheral temple lanes.

Ranipet.safety_recommendations: Heavy industrial movement, choose hotels with 24-hour guarded parking.

Vellore.safety_recommendations: Active city center around CMC and Fort. Avoid unlit bypass service lanes late at night.

Tirupattur.safety_recommendations: Highway dining hubs like Ambur are vibrant; keep to well-reviewed family rest stops.

Krishnagiri.safety_recommendations: Interstate transit corridor, high police highway patrol presence on NH-44.

Dharmapuri.safety_recommendations: Low street crime, main risk is mountain highway curves (Thoppur Ghat).

Salem.safety_recommendations: Major junction city with lively night traffic; stick to well-patrolled arterial roads.

Erode.safety_recommendations: Very high safety ratings, welcoming civic environment, reputable highway rest stops.

Tiruppur.safety_recommendations: Industrial commercial hub; safe highway motels along bypass.

Coimbatore.safety_recommendations: Ranked among safest tier-2 cities in India; 24x7 emergency medical infrastructure.

The Nilgiris.safety_recommendations: Lowest crime rate in Tamil Nadu. The primary risks are wildlife crossings (elephants/bison) at night and steep mountain roads. Keep headlights bright, avoid walking in isolated reserve forests after sunset.
